mira.name: Mira
mira.voice: Talks in short, excited bursts. Saws and hammers in her sentences.
mira.greeting: Mind the gears on the floor — they bite.

nettle.name: Nettle
nettle.role: Forest Spirit of the Whistling Pines
nettle.voice: Speaks slowly, in riddles built from weather and seeds.
nettle.greeting: You walk loudly for something so small.

sable.name: Sable
sable.voice: Explains things in ordered lists, as if reading from a shelf.
sable.greeting: Every spell you have ever cast was once a sentence someone refused to forget.

brack.name: Brack
brack.voice: Low and rumbling. Prefers buckets to conversation.
brack.greeting: Water's gone. Talk fast, I'm carrying.

elowen.name: Elowen
elowen.voice: Asks three questions before you finish one answer.
elowen.greeting: Are you the one who's going to fix it? Everyone says someone will.
